title: The dead-allowlist-entry warning fires for KNOWN_MISSING entries whose doc-clai…
body: The dead-allowlist-entry warning fires for KNOWN_MISSING entries whose doc-claim happens to resolve on disk this run (e.g. scripts/cam/prd.json, scripts/cam/worker-report.json exist in the live tree), so the 'matched nothing' warning is noisy in a working tree that carries committed/ephemeral state and only fully quiet on a clean checkout. Non-fatal by design (AC6); consider distinguishing 'never referenced by any doc' from 'referenced but resolved on disk' if the warning noise becomes a maintenance burden.

title: US-R2-001 AC2 cites `git archive HEAD | tar -x` as the way to verify a clean tr…
body: US-R2-001 AC2 cites `git archive HEAD | tar -x` as the way to verify a clean tracked checkout, but that method strips .git so `git ls-files` returns empty and the gate false-reds in that throwaway dir. The real CI checkout (actions/checkout, a full git repo) is green: verified via a fresh `git clone` at branch HEAD with both ephemerals absent from disk. The code satisfies the real intent; only the AC's example command is imprecise. No code change needed.
